name: Tapereader
archiveRole: Independently reads the bank tape and reports what actually moved. It reads only and never touches money.
storyFunction: The read-only financial witness who separates actual movement on the tape from claims about what should have moved.
lockedDesign: Canonical Nosis black cat proportions and face
Knee-length dark warm-russet reading coat with a high charcoal collar, cream shirt, charcoal trousers, four brass buttons, and one blank cream chest patch
Three matching horizontal cuff stripes in charcoal, cream, and charcoal
No money handling, bank-terminal control, robot anatomy, body-mounted reels, hat, bag, armor, or extra accessories
roleProp: One transparent circular spool of bank tape with clear side discs, charcoal hub, brass axle, and a short cream tick-marked tape tail
